title: Migrate ZUGFeRD, PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE, Factur-X FR and Peppol BIS 3.0 FR to the V2 draft import pipeline
summary: German ZUGFeRD and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE formats and French Factur-X and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 FR formats are now migrated to the V2 draft import pipeline, enabling the draft-based workflow and Copilot-assisted matching previously unavailable for these localized e-document formats.
key_points: ZUGFeRD and Factur-X handlers parse CII XML and can extract it from a PDF/A-3 container
PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE reuses the existing XRechnung UBL reader; Peppol BIS 3.0 FR gets a new UBL reader
French SIRET party identifiers written on export are mapped back on import
New Buyer Reference DE field on E-Document Purchase Header stores the Leitweg-ID but is not shown in the UI yet
New Read into Draft and Structure Received enum values; selecting these formats on a service defaults the read into draft implementation
